name: archive_agent
description: Archive a collaborator you created once its work is done, or when it can no longer work, for example because its model or provider failed. To retry its work on a working model, switch it with model fields on send_agent_message, or archive it and create a new collaborator. Stops its current work and running descendants, but marks only that collaborator archived. It no longer counts toward the collaborator limit and can no longer receive messages. Conversation history remains, and repeating archival is harmless. Use archive_subtask for subtasks.
